draft.strengthQuote: Played rare volume of high-leverage games as three-year starter.
draft.weaknessQuote: Benefits from heavy play-action and quick game.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.40, the 1st-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 10 at QB. He went 1st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: vertical jump (95th percentile). College production: 3,153 passing yards in 2020, 4th of 10 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 77 career games and 77 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (15 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passing td 29 (86th percentile), passing yards 4,007 (80th percentile), approximate value 15 (77th percentile). Weak spots: sacks taken 41 (16th percentile), interceptions thrown 12 (24th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 quarterback who played: 4,007 passing yards against a median of 1,226, above the norm.
